title: ShowPapers modern Scratch content v1
$comment: Runtime additionally enforces UTF-16 length and scalar boundaries, start < end <= text length, nonoverlapping link ranges, in-archive Paper resolution, exact manifest Paper references, byte limits and no unknown fields. Bold/italic marks may overlap and are preserved in order. This content profile does not encode legacy checklist items or internal vault metadata.

text.description: Exact modern Note text. LF and tab are allowed; carriage returns and other control characters are rejected. Native checklist lines start exactly with U+2610 plus U+0020 (☐ ) or U+2611 plus U+0020 (☑ ), with no indentation, at the beginning of text or just after LF. Native editors draw their rounded check control over these markers. Markdown - [ ] and other squares remain literal text. Bullets use • plus U+0020. Calculate marks and paperLinks as UTF-16 offsets into the final text.
